statement: Users seeking a simple bill and due-date checklist are forced into complex budgeting apps that demand extensive account linking and category setups.
normalized_problem: Overly complex budgeting software for simple bill listing needs
desired_outcome: A clean, straightforward app or tool that strictly lists bills and due dates without forced budgeting features.
solution_complaints: Budgeting apps demand linking all financial accounts and setting spending goals when the user only wants a simple schedule of upcoming bills
path: Users seeking a simple bill and due-date checklist are forced into complex budgeting apps that demand extensive account linking and category setups.
